why: The Codex action takes its sandbox as an input, not as a switch on a run line, so a rule that needs the binary and the switch in one command never saw it. The fail side sets the no-sandbox value in a push workflow. The pass side keeps the workspace sandbox and carries a config override for the sandbox in codex-args, which the action overrides with its own choice, so it passes. Whoever ignores action inputs passes the fail side; whoever greps codex-args fails the pass side.
